run_extract_interesting_blocks: run the script to extract the most interesting compressed texture blocks from a DDS or KTX image file
run_decode_compressed_image: run the script to decode a compressed BC or ETC format image and write decoded blocks to an output file
run_analyze_block_ranges: run the script to analyze per-block pixel value ranges and find high-contrast blocks in a compressed texture
run_export_interesting_blocks: run the script with offset and count arguments to export specific interesting blocks as a standalone image
run_print_block_hex: run the script to print C-style hex character arrays for the most interesting compressed texture blocks
